rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a good-quality expanded Day-5 blastocyst with plausible comments on ICM, TE, and thinned zona; appropriately notes uncertainty between 3AA and 4AA from a single static image without obvious fabrication.

Comprehensively integrates age, endometriosis, AMH, BMI, prior IVF failure, oocyte maturity yield, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, protocol, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overinterpretation from a single image and some speculative points about receptivity workup.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: SET for a young patient with a good-quality blastocyst, caution on routine PGT-A at age 30, and appropriate endometriosis/lifestyle counseling; a few suggestions are more individualized than guideline-mandated.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support adherence, lifestyle changes, evaluation for adenomyosis/hydrosalpinx, consideration of FET strategy, and review of trigger/maturation issues.
